redfin.remarks: Rare opportunity at Park Homes in Playa Vista, an exclusive collection of 10 limited-edition residences in the heart of Silicon Beach. This 3-story detached home offers 3 beds, 3.5 baths, and a private elevator , situated on a premium treelined street just 1.5 miles from the ocean. The main level features a formal dining room with french doors to a front patio, an expansive kitchen with stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, and built-in wine fridge , plus an oversized living room with stone tile accent wall and access to a private backyard retreat with fireplace lounge. The second level offers two en-suite bedrooms, one with private outdoor access, plus a versatile bonus room perfect as a home office, den, or media space. The entire third floor is a luxurious primary suite with fireplace, private balcony, two large walk-in closets and spa-inspired bathroom with soaking tub and glass-enclosed shower. The private rooftop deck delivers beautiful views and fresh ocean breezes, ideal for entertaining under the California sky. Additional highlights: central HVAC, modern finishes, private 2-car garage, dedicated underground parking, guest parking and community EV chargers. Located in Playa Vista, just north of LAX, with access to The Resort and CenterPointe Clubhouse, pools, tennis, dog parks, beach shuttles, farmer's markets, restaurants, grocery, and a movie theater. Home to 29 parks and 500+ businesses including Google, YouTube, and Electronic Arts.
